_doc: Pi-IR projection of redacted_thinking_block/messages_sse.json. Pi's content_block.type switch in claude-agent-sdk-pi/index.ts has NO arm for redacted_thinking — verified by ripgrep against refs/anthropic/claude-agent-sdk-recon-2026-06-23/upstream/claude-agent-sdk-pi/index.ts (zero matches). Anthropic emits redacted_thinking blocks when the model returns a thinking block that is safety-redacted; XLI MUST preserve it for byte-identical replay using the sentinel-prefixed encrypted_content ('\u0000REDACTED\u0000<data>') and raw_wire_block. Closes RI-010 (redacted_thinking BLOCKS_PROD HI-C1-008).
_pi_state_machine_branches_MISSING: content_block.type:redacted_thinking — pi has no arm; XLI extension via BlockState::RedactedThinking (sse/messages.rs:657-678)
_uses_strict_order: XLI emits [Reasoning, Message] in SSE order; the simple append (project(text) ++ Reasoning) would produce [Message, Reasoning]. Use _xli_full_sequence to lock the interleaved ordering.
